title: Mapping the AI Supply Chain: Dependencies, Vulnerabilities, and Market Concentration in the AI Ecosystem
abstract: arXiv:2611.24927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI systems are built across many organizations that contribute models, data, compute, capital, talent, and other assets. While the layers of the AI stack are relatively well understood, the relationships between actors and components across layers remains sparsely documented. In this work, we focus on the organizations that make up the AI supply chain: the complex network of actors that contribute to the development and deployment of AI. We motivate the examination of the organizational AI supply chain---highlighting concerns about concentration, power, chokepoints, cascading failures, fragmented accountability, and risk---then describe our pipeline for mapping the AI supply chain. Our pipeline yields our main contribution: a multilayered, large-scale dataset of actors and relationships in the AI ecosystem, annotated with dates, descriptions, types, tags, and more. translated_title: 绘制AI供应链图谱：AI生态系统中的依赖关系、脆弱性与市场集中度
translated_abstract: AI系统由众多组织共同构建，这些组织提供模型、数据、算力、资本、人才等资产。尽管AI技术栈的各个层次已相对清晰，但跨层次的参与者与组件之间的关系却鲜有系统记载。在本工作中，我们聚焦于构成AI供应链的组织，即参与AI开发与部署的复杂行动者网络。我们论证了研究组织层面AI供应链的必要性——着重指出了关于市场集中化、权力、关键瓶颈点、级联故障、碎片化问责以及风险等方面的担忧——随后描述了我们用于绘制AI供应链图谱的技术流程。该流程产出了我们的主要贡献：一个多层级、大规模的AI生态系统行动者及其关系数据集，并附带日期、描述、类型、标签等标注信息。这项工作朝着系统性绘制与测量AI生态系统迈出了重要一步。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个多层级、大规模的AI供应链数据集，系统绘制了AI生态系统中各组织间的依赖关系与脆弱性，并揭示了AI产业中的关键瓶颈点与市场集中度问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a multilayered, large-scale dataset that maps the AI supply chain, systematically documenting dependencies, vulnerabilities, chokepoints, and market concentration among actors in the AI ecosystem.
